info.description: API for VitalFit, a gym system management
info.title: VitalFit API

get.description: Lists all permissions defined in the system (from the seeder) that can be assigned to roles.
List all roles in the system

post.description: Creates a new custom role with a name, description, and an initial set of permission IDs.

400.description: Bad Request: Invalid payload or permissions not found

409.description: Conflict: A role with this name already exists

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific role, including its assigned permissions.

put.description: Updates a role's name, description, and overwrites its assigned permissions with the new set provided.

400.description: Bad Request: Invalid UUID or payload

delete.description: Deletes a custom role from the system.

post.description: Assigns one or more permissions to a specific role. This is additive; it does not remove existing permissions.

parameters.description: List of permission IDs to assign
parameters.name: payload

400.description: Bad Request: Invalid UUID or payload

delete.description: Revokes one or more permissions from a specific role based on the provided permission IDs.

parameters.description: List of permission IDs to revoke
parameters.name: payload

400.description: Bad Request: Invalid UUID or payload

put.description: Activates a user's account using the invitation code/token.

204.description: User successfully activated. No content returned.

404.description: Code is invalid or expired (handled by the service layer returning ErrNotFound)

500.description: Internal server error (e.g., database connection issue)

put.description: Activates a staff user's account using the invitation token from the URL and sets their initial password.

204.description: User successfully activated and password set. No content returned.

400.description: Bad request (e.g., invalid JSON payload, passwords do not match)

post.description: Authenticates the user with email and password, returning an access token upon success.
post.summary: Logs in a user and issues a JWT token

404.description: error":	"not found"							"User with the given email not found

500.description: error":	"the server encountered a problem"	"Internal server error during token generation or hashing

post.description: Envía un código OTP al correo electrónico proporcionado para iniciar el proceso de reseteo de contraseña.
post.summary: Solicitar token de reseteo de contraseña

parameters.description: Estructura que contiene el correo del usuario
parameters.name: email

200.description: Si el correo existe, el proceso de token ha sido exitoso (por seguridad, el mensaje no confirma la existencia del correo).

400.description: Bad Request - Datos de entrada inválidos (ej. formato de email incorrecto)

500.description: Internal Server Error - Error al generar el token, al acceder a la DB, o al enviar el correo.

post.description: Finalizes the password reset process by validating the token and updating the user's password hash.

parameters.description: Reset token and new password data (must include password confirmation).
parameters.name: body

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid data (expired token, token not found, or passwords do not match).

500.description: Internal Server Error - Error while hashing the password or executing the DB transaction.

get.description: Checks if a password reset token is valid and has not expired.

404.description: Token is invalid or has expired.

Register a new user in the system with and specific role

get.description: Retrieves a list of all available fiscal document types in the system.

post.description: Adds a new fiscal document type to the system.
post.summary: Create a new fiscal document type

get.description: Retrieves a single fiscal document type by its UUID.
get.summary: Get fiscal document type by ID

put.description: Updates an existing fiscal document type's details.

delete.description: Deletes a fiscal document type from the system.

post.description: Creates a new invoice for a specific user and branch, containing a list of items. If the user making the request is a client, the invoice is created for them. If the user is staff (with 'billing:create_invoice' permission), the 'user_id' in the payload is required to specify for whom the invoice is being created.

400.description: Bad Request (e.g., invalid payload, missing user_id for staff)

post.description: Adds a payment to an existing invoice. Clients can only pay their own invoices. Staff with 'billing:process_payment' permission or super admins can add payments to any invoice.
post.summary: Add a payment to an invoice

400.description: Bad Request (e.g., invalid payload, currency not supported)

403.description: Forbidden (user does not have permission or is trying to pay another user's invoice)

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific invoice by its UUID. The user must have access to the invoice (either be the owner, a super_admin, or have 'billing:get' permission).

403.description: Forbidden (user does not have access to this invoice)

get.description: Retrieves a list of all available payment methods in the system.

200.description: A list of available payment methods

post.description: Adds a new payment method to the system.

get.description: Retrieves a single payment method by its UUID.

put.description: Updates an existing payment method's details.

delete.description: Deletes a payment method from the system.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific payment by its UUID. The user must have access to the associated invoice.

403.description: Forbidden (user does not have access to this payment's invoice)

patch.description: Updates the status of a specific payment. This is restricted to users with 'billing:process_payment' permission or super admins.

400.description: Bad Request (e.g., invalid UUID or status)

get.description: Retrieves the latest currency exchange rates from the configured provider. It uses a cache to avoid hitting the API on every request.

200.description: A map of currency codes to their exchange rates against the base currency (USD)

404.description: Currency not found for the given date

get.description: Retrieves the latest exchange rate for a specific currency code.

200.description: The exchange rate for the specified currency
